spans.s:
Yūpa in the Rigveda^1 and later^2 means a ‘post,’ usually that
to which the sacrificial victim was tied. It also designates the
post to which the door of the house was attached (Durya).^3
1) v. 2, 7 (of Sunaḥśepa).
2) Av. ix. 6, 22; xii. 1, 38; xiii. 1, 47;
Taittirīya Saṃhitā, vi. 3, 4, 1; vii. 2,
1, 3; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xix. 17;
Pañcaviṃśa Brāhmaṇa; ix. 10, 2,
etc.
3) Rv. i. 51, 14. Cf. Zimmer, Altin-
disches Leben, 153.
